chain.title: Automate one repeatable craft
chain.desc: Power a Tier 1 Crafter, configure a recipe, and assign ingredient slots and output behavior. Run a small batch before connecting an unlimited resource supply.

chain.title: More recipes in the same station
chain.desc: Upgrade the Crafter when the process needs additional recipe slots. Choose which intermediate outputs stay inside for later recipes and which leave the machine.

chain.title: A compact production sequence
chain.desc: Use the larger Crafter for a sequence of dependent recipes. Reserve enough internal space for intermediates and test the complete sequence before increasing the input rate.

chain.title: Prepare a destination
chain.desc: Place and power a Matter Receiver at a safe destination. Name and configure access to it so the teleport route leads somewhere intentional.

chain.title: Build the departure station
chain.desc: Place and power a Matter Transmitter. A useful route needs an available receiver and a way to select the destination.

chain.title: Dial the first teleport route
chain.desc: Use the Dialing Device to link the intended transmitter and receiver. Test a short safe route, then verify the return option before adding remote destinations.

chain.title: Keep a portable way home
chain.desc: Bind and charge a Charged Porter for a prepared receiver. Test the connection while close to safety before depending on it during an expedition.

chain.title: Manage several return points
chain.desc: Upgrade to an Advanced Charged Porter and configure its supported destinations. Keep each destination powered and available when you travel.

chain.title: A display for the workshop
chain.desc: Place a Screen and add the desired modules. It needs the supported power arrangement and configuration before its useful information appears.

chain.title: Power the display group
chain.desc: Power a Screen Controller and scan for the intended screens. Recheck the detected group after moving displays or adding new ones.

chain.title: Label what the screen means
chain.desc: Configure a Text Module with a useful station label or instruction. Combine it with live readings so players can tell what a displayed value describes.

chain.title: Watch an energy buffer
chain.desc: Bind and configure an Energy Module for the intended machine or storage. Display it on a powered screen and verify its reading against the target's own interface.

chain.title: Show the resources that matter
chain.desc: Configure an Inventory Module for selected inventory information. Use it to expose shortages or output jams where the factory operator can see them.

chain.title: Send a control signal wirelessly
chain.desc: Place and configure a Redstone Transmitter for a deliberate channel. Test with a simple signal before using it to switch a valuable automated process.

chain.title: Receive the control channel
chain.desc: Configure the receiver to match the transmitter and test both on and off states. Wireless redstone controls a device; it does not supply the device's energy.

chain.title: Create a supported work area
chain.desc: Power an Environmental Controller and configure its area and player filters. Add only the effect modules you need so the ongoing energy demand stays intentional.

chain.title: Light the work area for its users
chain.desc: Install a Night Vision module in the configured controller. Verify the effect reaches the intended users and area before expanding the range.

chain.title: Flight inside the configured area
chain.desc: Install a Flight module with enough ongoing power. Test the boundary close to the ground; leaving the active area or losing power can remove the effect.

chain.title: Sample the intended creature
chain.desc: Use a Syringe to gather the mob information required by the spawning system. Check the sample status before building a farm around it.

chain.title: Plan a selected-mob farm
chain.desc: Place the Spawner in a prepared chamber with the configured syringe. Its resource requirements depend on the selected creature, so read them before building the supply lines.

chain.title: Feed the spawning recipe
chain.desc: Link powered Matter Beamers to the Spawner and supply the required matter categories. Test one spawn cycle and provide separate handling for the resulting mobs.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Effect modules are selected examples, not a demand to craft every variant.
Teleport routes and spawner settings require player configuration and are not detected by component acquisition.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.
